title: One sentence: what is being tested
locked: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ — taken from the clock, not from memory
lockProof: commit <hash> at <time>; a file timestamp is not proof
lockedBefore: what did NOT exist yet when this was locked (e.g. no result file, no trace)

hypotheses.ifWrong: what you will conclude and do
hypotheses.ifWrongInAnotherWay: the second way to be wrong (e.g. improves X but destroys Y)

population.stoppingRule: minimum n per group; computed ONCE, when first met; no peeking

metrics.groundTruth: where truth comes from — must not be the instrument under test
metrics.baseRateControl: precision / stratified comparison / matched coverage — not a raw rate

winnabilityCheck.ceiling: can the metric reach the WIN value at all?
winnabilityCheck.floor: is there a floor of genuine behaviour below the threshold? (C55)
winnabilityCheck.granularity: with n controls, one event = 100/n points

antiTests.rule: written from the form of language or the task, never from the data

confounds.name: noisy labels
confounds.control: blinded adjudication by someone who did not design the hypothesis

confounds.name: output length
confounds.control: length-only rule at the same false-alarm rate

mustNotDo: Tune the instrument until it passes.
Add items after reading the data.
Compute the metric before the stopping rule is met.

amendment_YYYY-MM-DD.written: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ — before the first data file
